staging.loginMethod: Test account — ask the PM for credentials. Do not use production accounts.

businessTasks.name: Login, session, profile
businessTasks.materials: One test account + one unregistered email
businessTasks.goal: Confirm login, logout, session expiry, signup flows are stable.
businessTasks.how: Log in; log out; log in again; try wrong password; refresh; toggle dark mode.
businessTasks.pass: All transitions work, no blank screens, clear copy on failed login.
businessTasks.caveats: Do not use real production accounts. Do not paste tokens in chat.

businessTasks.name: Responsive, dark mode, error recovery
businessTasks.goal: Confirm main pages survive 1440 / 1280 / 768 / 390 widths, dark mode, network drops.
businessTasks.how: Resize the browser, toggle dark, throttle to Slow 3G in DevTools, drop and restore network.
businessTasks.pass: No horizontal scrolling at 390px, dark text legible, restore-network recovers the page.
businessTasks.caveats: If you see horizontal overflow, screenshot at the actual width.

businessTasks.name: Release smoke (5 min)
businessTasks.goal: Shortest path to confirm there is no widespread breakage after a release.
businessTasks.how: Open home → log in → main workspace → core list view → click one read-only action.
businessTasks.pass: Every page returns 200, console has no red errors, navigation is clickable.
businessTasks.caveats: If smoke fails, roll back — do not start debugging.
